name: goal_add
description: Persist a structured goal without running it (write): creates a goal-card on the board plus a state/goals.json index entry for a later `run --goal <id>` or the goal board. Never executes the goal.
llm_description: Persist a structured goal without running it. Required: "objective". Optional: "completion_criterion" (the goal loop drafts one when omitted), "proof", "boundaries", "stop_rule", "max_iterations" (integer 1..1000), "worktree" (branch/path for worktree runs). Returns its id. A goal is a card (RFC 0001): this tool creates that card plus the goals.json index.
